country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.10
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.10.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.10.d
	picture = GFX_ICW_EVT_country_COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_session

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.10"
		# extra sessions do not move the calendar
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_extra_session }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_extra_session
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 0 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 1 } }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.10 days = 184 }
			}
			else = {
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 0 } }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.10 days = 181 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_january = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { date > 1970.12.20 date < 1971.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 9 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 9 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			if = { limit = { date > 1975.12.20 date < 1976.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 10 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 10 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			if = { limit = { date > 1980.12.20 date < 1981.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 11 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 11 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			if = { limit = { date > 1985.12.20 date < 1986.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 12 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 12 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			# the Union plan (cw_union.py): settle the old year, publish the new one - after a new Five-Year Plan has begun
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_january = 1 } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan > 8 } } COLDWAR_UNI_january_session = yes }
			# Socialist Emulation (cw_pbgui.py): the best republic of the year becomes the Pride of the Union
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_january = 1 } date > 1970.12.1 } COLDWAR_SOV_pb_award_pride = yes }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_patron_in_moscow } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_made
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.15 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.10.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

		var:COLDWAR_SOV_acc = { COLDWAR_SOV_investigate_republic = yes }

			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_proven } }

			base = 1

			base = 1
		}
	}
}

	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.43.d

		original_tag = SOV

		date > 1974.6.1
		has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_agrarian_problem
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_harvest_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_poor_harvest }
	}

		days = 900
	}

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.43"
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_harvest_cooldown days = 1460 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_poor_harvest days = 120 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.53 days = 120 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.43.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.44
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.44.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.44.d
	picture = GFX_ICW_EVT_country_sov_russ_dissolved

	trigger = {
		original_tag = SOV
		has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_system
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion < 15 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_disintegration_cooldown }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — The Unbreakable Union BEGIN
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_on }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — The Unbreakable Union END
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 30
	}

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.44"
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_disintegration_cooldown days = 365 }
		every_subject_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_declaration_of_sovereignty } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_declaration_of_sovereignty }
			else_if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.54 days = 1 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.44.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		add_stability = -0.05
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.80
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.80.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.80.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_communist_congress

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.80"
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_congress_open
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applied NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_25 } add_political_power = 12 }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_50 } add_political_power = 25 }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_100 } add_political_power = 50 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_25
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_50
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_100
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_cadre_protection
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_slanderer } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_slanderer }
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_disgrace_left = -1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_disgrace_left < 1 } } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_rotate_cadres NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat_changed_this_congress } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_seat_count > 0 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.81 days = 1 }
		}
		news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.37 hours = 6 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.80.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

	id = COLDWAR_SOV.90
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.90.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.90.d
	picture = GFX_ICW_EVT_country_report_event_generic_funeral

	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		# COLDWAR SP DEATH GUARD
		NOT = { COLDWAR_SP_1970_human_sov = yes }
		original_tag = SOV
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_initialized
		NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_dead_bre }
		OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kremlin_doctors } date > 1982.11.9 } AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kremlin_doctors date > 1984.11.9 } }
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 30
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { COLDWAR_SP_1970_human_sov = yes }
			}
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.90"
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_dead_bre
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_candidate_bre
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_bre } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_bre }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.90.a
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre
			emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { COLDWAR_SP_1970_human_sov = yes }
			}
			COLDWAR_SOV_succession = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.90.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes } }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre NOT = { COLDWAR_SP_1970_human_sov = yes } } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre }
	}
}

	}

			base = 1

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.185
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.185.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.185.d
	picture = GFX_event_olympics

	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = SOV
		has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_system
		NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_federation_council }
		date > 1971.7.24
		check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_edition = 5 }
		has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_open
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 1
	}
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.185"
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_open
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_edition = 5 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			COLDWAR_UNI_weight_of = yes
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = COLDWAR_UNI_w } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = 2 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_pts } }
			set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_luck min = 0 max = 7 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_luck } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = -1 }
		clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_gold
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_gold = THIS } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top > -1 } } var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_gold = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.172 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = -1 }
		clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_silver
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_silver = THIS } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top > -1 } } var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_silver = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.174 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = -1 }
		clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_bronze
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_bronze = THIS } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top > -1 } } var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_bronze = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.175 } } }
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_held
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 2 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { original_tag = SOV COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.171 hours = 6 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.185.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.189"
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_open
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_edition = 9 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			COLDWAR_UNI_weight_of = yes
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = COLDWAR_UNI_w } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = 2 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_pts } }
			set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_luck min = 0 max = 7 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_luck } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = -1 }
		clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_gold
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_gold = THIS } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top > -1 } } var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_gold = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.172 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = -1 }
		clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_silver
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_silver = THIS } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top > -1 } } var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_silver = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.174 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = -1 }
		clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_bronze
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_bronze = THIS } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top > -1 } } var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_bronze = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.175 } } }
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_medal }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_sp_held
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 2 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { original_tag = SOV COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.171 hours = 6 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.189.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}

			base = 30
		}
		hidden_effect = {

					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_sov01_145_signed

				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_sov01_145_pending

					COLDWAR_SOV_sov01_accept_145_KAZ = yes
